newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank leaves interest rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank leaves interest rates unchanged.

text.p: German'ys central bank left its key discount and Lombard rates unchanged Thursday at its regular policy-setting meeting.
the Bundesbank left the discount rate at 2.50 percent and the Lombard emergency financing rate at 4.50 percent. The central bank's main money market rate, the repo, was also held steady at 3 percent.
Economists had said that the chances of the Bundesbank cutting rates at the meeting, or at any other time in 1997, were slim.
The Bundesbank last cut its discount and Lombard rates in April. It cut the repo to 3 percent in August.
